title: EXTRACTION ON THE PILL
why: his ask 10-27 ~21:40: the hud messaging is a clusterfuck, make it AAA (report reports/Player alerts and HUD messaging.md, job 6). The extract pill under the clock carries the state of its exit: teal open, amber in the two minute warning with a countdown in the last minute, red once shut, one pulse on each change. An open exit just off the screen is an edge arrow with its letter and distance (c 152m), slid along an oval inside the edges until it is clear of the corner panels and the pickup stack column; the extraction c available line under the pill is gone. The sky (weather, else the time of day) is a small icon beside the clock. Looting is untouched.
now: the extract pill turns amber and counts down when your exit is closing; an exit off screen is an edge arrow with its letter and distance; the sky is an icon by the clock
